entities.summary: Joe Stump is an American guitarist from Queens, New York. He has played for the bands Exorcism, Raven Lord, HolyHell, Alcatrazz and has an extensive solo career. He is an associate professor at Berklee College of Music. His main musical influences are Ritchie Blackmore, Yngwie Malmsteen, Gary Moore, Michael Schenker, and Uli Jon Roth. Guitar One magazine ranked Stump as the sixth fastest shredder of all time.
